experimental_design.evidence: inferred: A total of 34 retrospectively collected, untreated primary breast tumor specimens from young women (<40), with an equal number of tumors from older women (≥60), matched by race and IHC subtypes (based on ER, PR, HER2, Ki67), were selected for study from the CBCP.

factor_value.evidence: inferred: We performed a first-ever integrated proteogenomic study from a matched cohort of laser-microdissected tumors of 34 young (<40 years) and 34 older (≥60 years) women to identify molecular features that may underlie the worse outcomes in young women.

number_of_biological_replicates.evidence: Briefly, tumor cell populations were denoted by expert pathological review followed by collection using LMD from fresh-frozen tissue sections (10 micron) on polyethylene naphthalate membrane slides for n = 68 unique patient tumors.

number_of_fractions.evidence: Each TMT-11 multiplex was loaded onto a C-18 trap column in 10 mM NH4HCO3 (pH 8.0) and resolved into 96 fractions through the development of a linear gradient of acetonitrile (0.69% acetonitrile/min) on a 1260 Infinity II liquid chromatograph (Agilent Technologies, Inc.).

number_of_samples.evidence: Briefly, tumor cell populations were denoted by expert pathological review followed by collection using LMD from fresh-frozen tissue sections (10 micron) on polyethylene naphthalate membrane slides for n = 68 unique patient tumors.

number_of_technical_replicates.evidence: TMT sample multiplexes, including eight technical replicate channels in which identical total peptide amounts for samples chosen at random were labeled in duplicate.
